messages.content: Predict one participant’s actual answer in a one-shot prisoner’s dilemma study. Each player’s initial resources are either 100 or 200 Japanese yen (JPY). Both players have the same action options and exchange technology, regardless of their initial resources. COOPERATE means paying exactly 100 JPY from your own resources; the organizer doubles that amount, so the other player receives 200 JPY. DEFECT means paying nothing, so you keep those 100 JPY and give the other player nothing. The other player makes the same kind of choice. Your game payoff is your own initial resources, minus 100 JPY if you cooperate, plus 200 JPY if the other player cooperates. Thus, relative to your initial resources, both cooperating adds 100 JPY to each player; your cooperation against defection subtracts 100 JPY from you and adds 200 JPY to the other player; your defection against cooperation adds 200 JPY to you and subtracts 100 JPY from the other player; both defecting changes neither player’s initial resources. Choosing a partner with 100 or 200 JPY refers to that partner’s initial resources, not an amount you donate. Participants are recruited through Yahoo! Crowdsourcing and are rewarded according to game earnings. The record does not provide the exact matching implementation, additional participation payment, or actual earnings.
